issues.jp_before: 兄[あに]は去年[きょねん]、大学[だいがく]を{出[で]ました|cl-life}。
issues.problem: The distractors were in the non-past ます form while the answer is the past ました form, so the mismatch gave the answer away.
issues.action: Changed the distractors to 入[はい]りました, 取[と]りました, 守[まも]りました.

issues.jp_before: 旅館[りょかん]に着[つ]いたら、すぐ温泉[おんせん]のお風呂[ふろ]に{入[はい]ろう|cl-life}と思[おも]っています。
issues.problem: 温泉のお風呂 is redundant and unnatural; native speakers say 温泉に入る.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 温泉[おんせん]に{入[はい]ろう|cl-life} and adjusted the why.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]は「年[とし]を{取[と]った|cl-life}ね」と笑[わら]いました。
issues.problem: Bare 年を取ったね reads as a remark about the listener; nothing showed that the mother meant herself, as the English says.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 「私[わたし]も年[とし]を{取[と]った|cl-life}なあ」 and changed the English to: Well, I've gotten old too.
